claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Esculin is a weakly active coumarin glucoside with no potent cytotoxic target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing likely reflecting weak antioxidant/anti-inflammatory or non-specific effects rather than a dominant cytotoxic mechanism.
